Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男孩名字叫孟子。孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人住在很穷的农村。他们住的地方旁边是个墓地，墓地老是有很多人祭拜。因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭。孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了，而且害得孟子的学习。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After describing the visitors, add one visible detail about their grief, such as “有人低着头，眼泪不停地流下来。”
2. When the boy sees the worshippers, add his reaction to make the scene more personal, such as “孟子觉得祭拜很有趣，常常学着他们的样子。”
3. Give the mother a short thought or line of speech before the final sentence, such as “孟子的妈妈叹了口气，说：‘这里不适合孩子成长。’”

ideas.reason: This adds a concrete, simple visual detail that fits the mourners at the cemetery.
Mencius imitating funeral rituals is an important detail in the traditional tale and explains the effect on him.
This gives the mother a fitting reaction and naturally leads into the decision to leave.
